g.text: Unknown-length target stream — prefix-independent retained memory
exact prefix result or tagged incomplete
depends on the fixed query, live frontier, and configured cache;
it does not depend on the number of target labels already consumed.
A budget, arithmetic, validation, or allocation failure is explicit.
It is never converted into a complete empty answer.
No exact fixed-query online automaton stores the consumed target history.
Exact distance between two mutually unbounded histories is not this contract.
